text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Ugh... it's tough! That guy, a magic wall...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
硬いっ！
やつめ、
魔法壁を……！

text_block_list.name: Shinatsu
text_block_list.text: Rushing in recklessly won't get us anywhere. First, let's attack from all sides and break through his defense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
闇雲に切り込んでも埒が明かんな。
まずは四方から攻め
やつの守りを切り崩す。

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: …Calmly and comprehensively grasping the battle situation. Impressive... Someday I want to reach this level...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……冷静で
大局的に戦況を把握している。
流石だ……
いつか私もこの域に……

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Shinatsu. I'll keep up with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すまないシナツ。
合わせるよ！
